title: Service topologyKeys removed

detection.reason: topologyKeys is a Service spec field the collected projection does not carry — Services are projected for their ports and selectors, not their alpha topology fields

quote: Remove support for the Service `topologyKeys` field (alpha) and the `kube-proxy` implementation of it. This field was deprecated several cycles ago. This functionality is replaced by the combination of automatic topology hints per-endpoint (alpha) and the Service `internalTrafficPolicy` field (alpha).
remediation: Replace `topologyKeys` with topology-aware hints plus `internalTrafficPolicy`. The field stops routing traffic the way it used to rather than being rejected, so a Service that still sets it silently spreads traffic cluster-wide after the upgrade.
verifyCommand: kubectl get svc -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.topologyKeys != null) | "\(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each Service printed still sets a field removed in 1.22
